title: Project Hail Mary
author: Andy Weir
description: Ryland Grace is the sole survivor on a desperate, last-chance mission—and if he fails, humanity and the earth itself will perish. Except right now, he doesn't know that. He can't even remember his own name.
aiPitch: If you love survival against astronomical odds solved by real science and an unexpectedly tender friendship, this is an unputdownable masterpiece.

title: Dark Matter
author: Blake Crouch
description: Are you happy with your life? Those are the last words Jason Dessen hears before the masked abductor knocks him unconscious. When he awakens, he's in a world where his life is not his own, his wife is not his wife, and his son was never born.
aiPitch: A breakneck sprint through alternate realities asking what we sacrifice for ambition. You will read this in a single breathless sitting.

title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
author: Yuval Noah Harari
description: From a renowned historian comes a groundbreaking narrative of humanity's creation and evolution that explores the ways in which biology and history have defined us.
aiPitch: Completely rewires how you view money, religion, nations, and human cooperation. Essential reading for anyone curious about why the world is the way it is.

title: The Thursday Murder Club
author: Richard Osman
description: In a peaceful retirement village, four unlikely friends meet weekly to investigate unsolved crimes. When a local developer is found dead, the Thursday Murder Club suddenly finds themselves in the middle of their first live case.
aiPitch: Charming, laugh-out-loud funny, and genuinely clever. Perfect for anyone who loves Agatha Christie mixed with warm eccentric camaraderie.

title: Neuromancer
author: William Gibson
description: Case was the sharpest data-thief in the matrix—until he crossed the wrong people and they crippled his nervous system. Now a mysterious new employer recruits him for a daring run on a powerful artificial intelligence orbiting earth.
aiPitch: The revolutionary classic that coined the term 'cyberspace'. If you crave gritty noir, cybernetic street samurai, and moody electronic vibes, start here.

title: Tomorrow, and Tomorrow, and Tomorrow
author: Gabrielle Zevin
description: On a bitter-cold day, in the December of his junior year at Harvard, Sam Masur exits a subway car and sees, amid the hordes of people, Sadie Green. He calls her name. For a moment, she pretends she hasn't heard him, but then she turns, and a game begins.
aiPitch: An exhilarating exploration of identity, video game art, creative partnership, and enduring friendship over three decades.

title: The Midnight Library
author: Matt Haig
description: Between life and death there is a library, and within that library, the shelves go on forever. Every book provides a chance to try another life you could have lived.
aiPitch: A comforting, introspective story about undoing regrets and realizing the infinite value of the life you already have.

title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
description: No matter your goals, Atomic Habits offers a proven framework for improving—every day. James Clear reveals practical strategies that will teach you exactly how to form good habits, break bad ones, and master tiny behaviors that lead to remarkable results.
aiPitch: No fluff, pure practical psychology. The single highest-leverage book on habit formation ever written.
